research_question: Across all 22 previously frozen GWTC-5 O4b events, does a semantically corrected common-5 public-summary model-spread score positively rank full posterior model-distance under the exact IMRPhenomXPHM-SpinTaylor / IMRPhenomXPNR / NRSur7dq4 triad?
estimand: The event-level rank association between corrected summary median spread normalized by central-90-percent widths and the median normalized 1-Wasserstein posterior distance across the exact 15 model-pair/parameter cells.

pre_lock_exposure.out_of_frame_semantic_probe: One locked noncandidate event/model, five fields, 72910 posterior scalar elements; no inter-model distance.

summary_semantic_contract.runtime_cell_gate: For every event/model/parameter, mask flags must be false; median/lower/upper must be finite; lower and upper must be nonnegative; lower+upper must be strictly positive.
summary_semantic_contract.failure: NO_GO_SUMMARY_SEMANTIC_COMPLETE_FRAME; no event replacement or reduction.

predictor.name: corrected_summary_median_max_pair_s90_common5_alttriad
predictor.interpretation: Median separation divided by the mean of the two central-90-percent half-widths.
predictor.per_parameter_aggregation: maximum across the three ordered model pairs

posterior_runtime_gate.file_identity: Observed size and MD5 must exactly match 03_INPUT/CANDIDATE_EVENT_FREEZE.csv; compute and record SHA-256.
posterior_runtime_gate.schema: Each exact C00:<model>/posterior_samples compound dataset must contain all five numeric scalar fields and no explicit weight-like field.

posterior_response.name: median_posterior_model_norm_W1_common5_alttriad
posterior_response.cleaning: Flatten exact field and retain finite values only.
posterior_response.full_w1: scipy.stats.wasserstein_distance with implicit equal sample weights
posterior_response.independent_w1_check: Exact empirical-CDF integral on sorted samples; require agreement within 1e-10*max(1,abs(W1)).
posterior_response.scale: Mean of the two posterior IQRs; if nonfinite or <=0, population standard deviation of concatenated samples; floor at 1e-12.

balanced_sensitivity.cell_seed: base_seed + (little-endian integer from first four SHA256 bytes of 'event|model_a|model_b|parameter') mod 1000000000
balanced_sensitivity.sampling: For each pair use n=min(n_a,n_b,4000), then draw n values without replacement independently from each model cell in every repetition. If a cell already has n values, its permutation leaves the empirical distribution unchanged.
balanced_sensitivity.event_aggregation: For each repetition take median across 15 normalized balanced cells, then median across 80 repetitions.

primary_test.statistic: Spearman rho implemented as Pearson correlation of average ranks
primary_test.ties: Allowed; scipy average ranks are frozen.
primary_test.permutation_generation: For each replicate, stable argsort of 22 independent uniform variates produces a permutation of the frozen y-rank vector; batches do not alter RNG order.
primary_test.non_support: All other nonconstant outcomes are NOT_SUPPORTED; no adaptive permutations or rescue test.
primary_test.monte_carlo_diagnostic: Two-sided 99% Clopper-Pearson interval for extreme_count/1000000, diagnostic only and not used to change the frozen decision.

allowed: balanced-response Spearman rho and the same fixed one-million-permutation diagnostic
Kendall tau-b for the full response

execution_order: Verify new protocol/source/test hashes and pre-posterior attestation.
Verify summary identity and compute all-22 corrected predictor.
Download event HDF files sequentially in frozen CSV order; verify identity; compute and independently check cells; delete each HDF immediately.
Stop at the first frozen gate failure without replacement.
Only after all 22 pass, compute the primary and frozen secondary statistics.
Run independent output verifier, build manifest and package.
claim_boundary: At most, this run can support or not support rank-screening utility of the corrected summary score for full posterior differences in this exact release, 22-event frame, model triad and common-5 set. It cannot establish strict replication, model truth or superiority, causal waveform bias, population/selection/ringdown/cosmology propagation, GR/Kerr/no-hair/anomaly/new physics, or generalization to another release.
